correctness.rationale: Monomial basis and radial projection give explicit weights. Mixed commutator equals a bilateral shift times diagonal coefficients; reflection pairs each coefficient in opposite sign, the transition block cancels, and strict log-convex gamma moments give positive doubled tails. The polygamma double-difference yields b_r=(alpha+1)mn/r²+O(r^-3), hence s_j~4(alpha+1)mn/j², p>1/2 threshold and logarithmic coefficient. All parameters are quantified, and checker supports finite algebra only.
